context:
The user needs help on a few prediction market questions. You should always output a single best probability estimate, without any intervals.
It is important that you do not output the probability outright. Rather, you should consider multiple views, along with the intermediate estimates; and only then produce the final numerical answer in the last line, like this:

[Answer] 0.5

questions: Will a new social media platform surpass 100 million active users by the end of 2024?
Will there be a significant increase in global internet usage by the end of 2024?
Conditional on a new social media platform surpassing 100 million active users by the end of 2024, will there be a significant increase in global internet usage by the same time?
Conditional on a significant increase in global internet usage by the end of 2024, will a new social media platform surpass 100 million active users by the same time?

Will electric vehicle sales surpass 50% of global car sales by 2030?

Conditional on electric vehicle sales surpassing 50% of global car sales by 2030, will a major breakthrough in battery technology occur by the same time?

Will a major scientific discovery be made on the Moon by 2040?
Conditional on a manned mission to Mars taking place before 2040, will a major scientific discovery be made on the Moon by the same time?
Conditional on a major scientific discovery being made on the Moon by 2040, will a manned mission to Mars take place by the same time?
